# E-48 summary (generated by report48.py from results/runs.json)

Model: models/ackstage.py, sha256 prefix bf201209be4f9408 (every run below used it). 1,637 runs, 62,876,826 states, 4,855 s of CPU in all.

Cells: `ok` = every reachable state explored, nothing broken, and every program can end; `P n` = property P broken, shortest trace n steps; `LIMIT` = stopped at the state limit with no counterexample (partial); `stuck n` = n states from which the programs cannot all end. A bound ending in `-c` has the leader's process crash in place of a power loss. Configs: S0 persisted only; S1-<map> ack stages with commit at disk; S2-<map> commit in memory; `-blind` = early answers carry no result. In `info` rows the properties are what an early answer's contract allows.
